title: Nephi speaks again
summary: Those seeking to destroy Nephi do not lay hands on him because of fear. Having gained favor with some, Nephi speaks again. He recounts the Red Sea account and asks why they dispute that God has given him power to know of coming judgments unless they repent.

explicit_facts.text: Those seeking to destroy Nephi do not lay hands on him because of fear.
Nephi gains favor with some of the people and begins speaking again; the remainder fear.
In his speech, Nephi recounts that God gave Moses power over the Red Sea waters, that the Israelites crossed on dry ground, and that the waters swallowed the Egyptian armies.
Nephi asks why they dispute that God has given him power to know of judgments to come unless they repent.
